verdict.rationale: Wise publishes an extensive public API reference at docs.wise.com/api-reference. It covers business payments from a Wise account, multi-currency balances, batch transfers, statements in many formats, cards, spend controls, and webhook subscriptions, which is enough to drive core business operations programmatically. An llms.txt file is also served for AI consumption. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec at standard paths (the probe returned 404 on all candidates), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
